info.title: OceanSight-V Scientific API
info.description: Scientific ocean data API backed by INCOIS HYCOM, INCOIS Argo, GEBCO 2026, RECCAP2 Ocean regional masks, and the OceanSight-V 4D navigation engine. Real source observations can be acquired live when they are not already available locally.

get.description:
Return the five supported real ocean-region masks.

These names are sourced from the real regional-mask engine and are
intended for the Earth-screen ocean selector.

schema.title: Response Ocean Regions Api V1 Ocean Regions Get

get.description:
Resolve a geographic coordinate against the real ocean-region mask.

Important:

    Clicking Earth does NOT call this endpoint automatically.

    SEARCH is the action that should call this endpoint.

The endpoint never invents an ocean name.

schema.title: Response Ocean Identify Api V1 Ocean Identify Get

get.description:
Return a real GEBCO numerical bathymetry surface masked to the selected
RECCAP2 ocean geometry.

This endpoint is intended to feed the 3D ocean-floor renderer. It returns
the source grid, elevation, missing-data mask, water mask and provenance.
No interpolation or synthetic bathymetry is performed.

schema.title: Response Ocean Bathymetry Api V1 Ocean Bathymetry Get

get.description:
Return the exact polygonal boundary represented by the real RECCAP2
regional mask for the requested ocean.

The returned geometry is derived from source mask cell edges. No
synthetic polygon, coordinate heuristic, or interpolation is used.

schema.title: Response Ocean Boundary Api V1 Ocean Boundary Get

get.description:
Return a real multi-depth selected-ocean volume.

The API combines the exact RECCAP2-derived ocean geometry with real INCOIS
HYCOM source-grid slices. Values outside the selected ocean polygon are
explicitly masked instead of being rendered as ocean data.

schema.title: Response Ocean Volume Api V1 Ocean Volume Get

get.description:
Return unified real scientific data for Ocean Dashboard or Block Dashboard.

Connected HYCOM variables are routed to the real multi-depth volume engine.
Bathymetry is routed to real GEBCO. Current speed/direction are calculated
only from real UVEL/VVEL fields. Unsupported variables return an explicit
501 instead of fabricated scientific data.

schema.title: Response Ocean Data Api V1 Ocean Data Get

get.description:
Return the canonical OceanSight variable catalog.

This endpoint is metadata-only: it never fabricates observations.  Each
variable declares its real source, vertical availability, units, and
whether the current backend can supply it from a connected scientific
source.  Derived variables explicitly declare the source fields required
to calculate them.

parameters.name: variable

schema.description: Optional variable id or source code to look up.
schema.title: Variable

parameters.description: Optional variable id or source code to look up.

schema.title: Response Ocean Variables Api V1 Ocean Variables Get

get.description:
Return the real HYCOM source timestamps inside a past/future window.

The frontend time slider must use this endpoint rather than inventing
six-hour or hourly timestamps. A future timestamp is classified as
future only when that exact timestamp exists in the source catalog.

parameters.name: reference_time_utc

schema.description: Reference time. When omitted, the backend uses the current UTC clock; only real source timestamps are returned.
schema.title: Reference Time Utc

parameters.description: Reference time. When omitted, the backend uses the current UTC clock; only real source timestamps are returned.

schema.title: Response Ocean Time Window Api V1 Ocean Time Window Get

get.description:
Return all real source timestamps inside an arbitrary calendar range.

This endpoint is intended for the calendar UI. The user may select any
supported year/month/day/time range; the response contains only source
timestamps that actually exist in the catalog.

schema.title: Response Ocean Time Range Api V1 Ocean Time Range Get

get.description:
Discover real observation platforms around a coordinate.

Phase 5 exposes only verified sensor sources. At present that means
INCOIS Argo floats. Other sensor categories remain explicitly marked as
unavailable until a real source is integrated.

get.description:
Return the shared scientific context used by Ocean Dashboard and Block Dashboard.

The endpoint resolves the selected ocean from a real regional mask, returns
the exact source-mask boundary, variable metadata, real source timestamps,
and optional sensor discoveries. Large numerical volume/bathymetry payloads
remain on their dedicated endpoints so the context response stays lightweight.

schema.title: Response Ocean Context Api V1 Ocean Context Get

post.description:
Calculate a real-data 4D navigation route.

Navigation is common to all OceanSight-V operational modes:

    disaster
    logistics
    fisheries
    naval

The supplied NavigationRequest selects the operating mode.

Temporal integrity:

    request.departure_time_utc
        = physical vessel departure time

    HYCOM model time
        = exact real INCOIS HYCOM source TIME

The navigation engine performs no synthetic-data fallback
and no interpolation.

Explicit Argo pressure metadata.

Neither represents depth.

Frontend-facing Argo profile/discovery response.

All returned profiles must correspond to real source observations.

ArgoProfilePoint.title: ArgoProfilePoint

One point in a real Argo vertical profile.

Scientific rule:

    pressure_dbar is PRES from the source.
    It is NOT depth.

ArgoProfileSeries.title: ArgoProfileSeries
ArgoProfileSeries.description: Complete real Argo profile selected for frontend visualization.

ArgoSourceObservation.title: ArgoSourceObservation
ArgoSourceObservation.description: Complete source metadata attached to an observation.

HYCOMMissing.title: HYCOMMissing
HYCOMMissing.description:
Explicit missing-value status for each HYCOM field.

True means the source did not provide a valid value.

NavigationConstraints.title: NavigationConstraints
NavigationConstraints.description:
Operational constraints used by the routing engine.

These are configuration values, not environmental observations.

NavigationMetrics.title: NavigationMetrics
NavigationMetrics.description:
Derived route metrics.

These values are calculated from the selected scientific inputs and
routing configuration.

minimum_arrival_time_utc.title: Minimum Arrival Time Utc
minimum_arrival_time_utc.description: Optional earliest physical vessel arrival time in UTC. When provided, the route cannot finish before this time.

requested_depth_m.title: Requested Depth M
requested_depth_m.description: Environmental current-field depth used for routing.

time_step_minutes.title: Time Step Minutes
time_step_minutes.description: Legacy/configuration field retained for API compatibility. The A* environmental timeline uses actual INCOIS HYCOM source-time intervals rather than inventing timestamps from this value.

NavigationRequest.title: NavigationRequest
NavigationRequest.description:
Common navigation request.

This is the request contract that every operational interface can use.

NavigationResult.title: NavigationResult
NavigationResult.description: Canonical response from the navigation engine.

time_utc.title: Time Utc
time_utc.description: Backward-compatible physical vessel arrival time in UTC.

vessel_time_utc.title: Vessel Time Utc
vessel_time_utc.description: Physical vessel arrival time for this route point.

model_time_utc.title: Model Time Utc
model_time_utc.description: Exact real INCOIS HYCOM source time used for the environmental state at this route point.

NavigationRoutePoint.title: NavigationRoutePoint
NavigationRoutePoint.description:
One point in the resulting route.

Environmental values are optional because a valid route should still
be representable when a particular field is unavailable.

Temporal semantics
------------------
`vessel_time_utc`
    Physical vessel arrival time for this route point.

`model_time_utc`
    Exact real INCOIS HYCOM source time used for environmental
    information at this route point.

`time_utc`
    Backward-compatible alias/value representing the physical vessel
    arrival time. Existing clients can continue using this field.

NavigationWaypoint.title: NavigationWaypoint
NavigationWaypoint.description:
A geographic waypoint.

Latitude and longitude are expressed in degrees.
Depth is optional because some routes are surface routes while
others may be constrained to a subsurface operating depth.

NavigationWeights.title: NavigationWeights
NavigationWeights.description:
Relative cost weights for the 4D routing engine.

These values are intentionally configurable so each operational mode
can use a different cost profile while sharing the same A* engine.
